title: SEC4: outbox_tick is 172 lines
description: kith-peer/src/lib.rs: outbox_tick (lines 837-1009) is 172 lines. It performs contact re-validation, mailbox_host validation, message load, attachment load, chat load, request building, and delivery result handling all in a single for-entry loop body. A future maintainer adding a new outbox entry type or delivery precondition would need to navigate the full function. Candidate extraction: a process_outbox_entry helper for a single entry, called from the loop.
notes: opinion: No project rule specifies a function length limit; the outbox_tick function is long but linear and sequential with clear step comments. No correctness, safety, or project-rule consequence. Pure style preference.
